verdict.rationale: Cursor documents several first-party ways to act on many items at once. Cloud agents can make coordinated changes across up to 20 repos and open PRs in each. You can launch parallel fleets of agents and subagents. The Admin API offers bulk spend limits, though only in preview. There is no general, documented bulk-operation primitive, and the headless per-file loop example relies on a user-side shell loop. missing for 10: a dedicated bulk/batch operation feature with documented semantics, bulk spend limits beyond preview, independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk edits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
